protocol: Each method/case/seed runs in a fresh process with one BLAS thread. Frozen workers perform one untimed warm-up and three timed repeats; the initial profile/gradient is measured before timing. Full fits use n=400, m=2, d=8/30 and one uninstrumented fit. Every worker has a 120-second timeout; failures remain in JSONL. Peak RSS is ru_maxrss.
